svg.font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
svg.title: Bayu Indoor, breadboard wiring
svg.desc: Phase-0 breadboard build of the Bayu Indoor node: Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3 on a half-size breadboard with a Plantower PMS5003 on its 8-pin cable, an SCD40 CO2 breakout and an SHT40 breakout. Every jumper is drawn in its net colour and ends on the XIAO pin it belongs to.
svg.text: XIAO ESP32-S3 + PMS5003 + SCD40 + SHT40 on a half-size breadboard. 5 V USB wall supply, WiFi only.
5 V, USB VBUS (PMS5003 fan and laser)
UART, D6 / GPIO43 TX and D7 / GPIO44 RX
Breadboard rows a-e are joined per column, so are f-j.
Long jumpers on the board carry a pin past the XIAO and
across the centre channel to a free column.
TXD (pin 5) to D7 / GPIO44, the XIAO receives on it.
RXD (pin 4) from D6 / GPIO43, SET (pin 3) from D2 / GPIO3.
SET high or open = running, low = fan and laser asleep.
RESET (6) has its own pull-up inside: leave 6, 7, 8 open.
Meshtastic (Bayu fork) drives D6 and D2 to sleep the fan.
Smart Citizen v5 only listens on D7 and never drives the PMS.
Wire D6 and D2 anyway: the same build runs either firmware.
